narrative: Inventory optimization analysis for PL1__M16F3A1E reveals a lumpy demand pattern with normal distribution (CV=0.57). Mean daily demand is 302.58 units with 94.9% non-zero days. Lead time is moderate (mean=0.0859 weeks, CV=0.20). Demand variability is the dominant factor (99.0% of total variance). Recommended policy: Safety stock of 84 units, reorder point at 111 units, and order quantity of 619 units (EOQ-based, constrained by MOQ=185 and storage capacity=1619). This achieves 95% service level target. Cost analysis shows the optimized policy reduces total annual cost by $8376.05 (37.6%) compared to SAP baseline (from $22275.32 to $13899.27). Review period is 3 days.

research_insights.selection_rationale: EOQ model selected due to lumpy demand pattern with normal distribution and moderate lead time. The model balances ordering and holding costs while maintaining 95% service level through safety stock buffer.
